Euler homogeneity fixes the multiplier \((m+1)/B\). Every boundary face and the interior satisfies the exact complementary-slackness system, exhausting positive prices including threshold equalities. Exact rational identities and direct numerical determinant/KKT checks corroborate the proof. All integers \(m\ge3\) and all real positive \(P,Q,R,B\) are covered analytically; finite checks do not stand in for proof.

value.rationale: Exact price-dependent support classification on a natural many-cycle graph with a globally shared edge, not a routine one-cycle optimization or small ad hoc instance. It determines which edge classes should receive no budget; at equal spoke prices \(P=Q=S\) the hub is deleted for \(R\ge4S/(m+1)\), creating a sharp and unexpected page-count transition. The formula remains valid for arbitrary positive real prices and budget and is usable without a general-purpose optimizer.
